name: devmesh
description: An evidence-based AI software engineering and website-operations orchestration framework with Codex and ChatGPT adapters, Mission Control, full-stack builds, WordPress, IDX/MLS/RESO, hosting/DNS/SSL, migrations, backups, SEO, Core Web Vitals, analytics, email deliverability, cron, recovery, and client reporting.

interface.shortDescription: AI engineering + Website Operations Specialist Mission Control
interface.longDescription: DevMesh v1.0 adds a Website Operations Specialist and Client Site Autopilot layer spanning hosting/DNS/SSL, WordPress migrations and restore drills, technical/real-estate SEO, Core Web Vitals, analytics/conversion QA, email deliverability, links/redirects, plugin/theme risk, WP-Cron reliability, RESO schema/provider inspection, emergency website recovery, and client monthly reporting. It builds on Mission Control, full-stack, WordPress Real Estate, IDX/MLS/RESO, Browser QA, security, accessibility, performance, CI, deployment, incident, review, memory, reporting, and Git delivery workflows. Codex uses the plugin adapter; ChatGPT uses the portable Agent Skills adapter.
defaultPrompt: DevMesh Website Specialist: take over this client website, audit operations end-to-end, fix safe issues, verify affected journeys, and prepare a client report.
DevMesh Deep: audit this WordPress real-estate website across hosting, DNS/SSL, backups, security, performance, SEO, analytics, email, IDX/MLS/RESO, listing freshness, and lead delivery.
DevMesh Emergency: this website is down; diagnose from DNS and SSL through hosting, WordPress and recent changes, stabilize safely, and prove recovery.
